tables.title: Moves
rows: His right fist charges with frost for about a 秒ond before he lunges into a punch that knocks you back、leaves you Frozen. The lunge scatters up to 15 ice mines along the ground it covers、so dodge sideways instead of staying in his wake.

Two quick jabs、a pause while both fists power up、then an ice punch (Frozen)、a lightning punch (Zapped)、a two-handed ground slam that applies both. Zapped greatly cuts your damage resistance right before that final slam、so use the power-up pause to roll out of range.

Put distance between you、he launches away、untargetable、invulnerable for about a 秒ond、then comes down on a marked spot by you、up to once every 6 秒onds. The landing point locks in a 秒ond before impact、so keep moving、step clear of the marker、then deal with the ring of ice mines that follows.

Eight mines appear in a ring around his Launch landings、and Forward strike scatters more along its path. Each bursts 2 秒onds after it appears for 冰霜 damage、冰冻、with a weaker splash reaching a little further、so keep clear of them until they pop.

Once he's lost a sliver of health、and at most every 40 秒onds after、he spends about two 秒onds calling in four to eight Pillagers、Vindicators、Royal Guards near one of the arena's platforms、never more than 10 alive at once. Each one is worth 20 souls more than usual.

Available from two-thirds health: he charges both fists、jumps、and slams down after about two、a half 秒onds、blasting a wide circle with heavy knockback、Zapped. Get well clear during the windup、since the slam also sends out a lightning ripple、and three of the arena's platforms rise shortly after it lands.
A ring of lightning spreads out from the slam point across most of the arena、hits each target once. Jump over it or roll through it.

Below half health、闪电 slam flows straight into Overcharge: he turns invulnerable、the arena floor carries current for 5 秒onds、hurting you for as long as you stand on it. Don't spend cooldowns on him while it runs、and move the moment it ends、because he launches straight at you、ice mines、all.
